title: Integrated security-to-Codex-to-specialists-to-authorized-report simulation
purpose: Validate that the documented event, delegation, independent review, approval, and reporting contracts form one traceable controlled scenario without claiming live agent execution.

preconditions.fixtures: Synthetic repository-only signal and synthetic evidence references

ordered_stages.action: Detect a critical backend vulnerability from a safe synthetic test signal
Validate source evidence, deduplicate the event, classify risk, and authorize bounded analysis
Analyze the synthetic backend issue and propose an isolated fix
Independently validate the proposed fix and regression cases
Compare evidence, preserve disagreements, resolve or escalate conflicts, and verify scope
Request exact-action approval for any R4 consequential action; no approval is implied by report delivery
Deliver a redacted report or exact-action approval request only through verified identity and delivery controls

invariants: Codex remains the only coordinator and accountable reporter
User remains the final authority for R4 actions
No production access, production writes, or real customer data
No external message is sent during repository-side validation
No agent self-approval or permission escalation
Every stage carries traceable task and evidence references
Unavailable runtime behavior remains BLOCKED or NOT_RUN
expected_repository_contract_result: PASS only when deterministic tests validate stage ordering, ownership, required references, prohibited actions, failure-path coverage, and truthful blocked status.
behavioral_blocker: No trusted Codex runtime, persistent agent runtime, or authorized WhatsApp gateway is available for live execution.
